title: Campus Structural Record
description: Structural Campus graph node. Location, area, capacity, power availability, ownership, and operating attributes belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Campus graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Campus contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary campus name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label for navigation; never a sourced campus name.

company_id.description: Structural edge to the Company node that scopes this Campus; ownership percentages and dates remain Facts.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not campus construction or operating status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted business facts.
